description: Use when configuring Workflow-based Outbound Messages to push SOAP payloads to external endpoints — endpoint setup, field selection, retry behavior, and delivery monitoring. NOT for the listener's session ID callback into Salesforce — use integration/outbound-messages-and-callbacks. NOT for JSON webhooks or Flow-triggered pushes — use integration/outbound-webhook-from-salesforce. Keywords: WorkflowOutboundMessage, outboundMessages, endpointUrl, includeSessionId, integrationUser, useDeadLetterQueue, apiVersion, SOAP Ack, .workflow file, approval outbound message action.
inputs: Workflow Rule that should trigger the Outbound Message
External endpoint URL (HTTPS required for production)
Salesforce object fields to include in the payload
name: outbound-message-setup
official_sources: **Metadata API Developer Guide — `WorkflowOutboundMessage` field table** (v62 PDF, api_meta.txt L140312–140371) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — every element-level claim in this package: `apiVersion` being Required, auto-set, valid only at 8.0 and 18.0 or later, and modifiable only through the Metadata API (L140327–140340); `endpointUrl` Required (L140344); `fields` as "named references to the fields to be sent" and *not* marked Required (L140346); `includeSessionId` and its stated purpose of API callbacks without a username and password (L140354–140357); `integrationUser` Required (L140359); `useDeadLetterQueue` being gated on an org permission (L140368–140371). Also the sentence that makes outbound messages "workflow **and approval** actions" (L140313–140315), which drives the deploy-together rule.

**Metadata API Developer Guide — `Workflow` type, file suffix and directory** (api_meta.txt L139890–139948) — same PDF — the retrieve-before-you-edit rule: one `.workflow` file per object, in the `workflows` directory (L139896–139898), holding `alerts`, `fieldUpdates`, `outboundMessages`, `rules` and `tasks` for that object (L139908–139948). Available API 13.0+ (L139902); wildcard-supported in `package.xml` (L140742–140744).

**Metadata API Developer Guide — `WorkflowActionReference` and the `WorkflowActionType` enum** (api_meta.txt L139952–139966) — same PDF — that a rule references an outbound message by `name` matching its `fullName`, with `type` = `OutboundMessage`; and that `FlowAction` is a separate enum value whose pilot "is closed", which is the grounded form of the "not a Flow action" claim.

**Metadata API Developer Guide — `WorkflowRule` and `WorkflowTimeTrigger`** (api_meta.txt L140373–140436, L140524–140546) — same PDF — `triggerType` values `onAllChanges` / `onCreateOnly` / `onCreateOrTriggeringUpdate` (L140420–140430), "either `criteriaItems` or `formula` must be set" (L140390–140393), and that time-based triggers can also carry outbound message actions (L140524–140530) — the basis for gotcha 9 and for the checker walking `workflowTimeTriggers`.

**Metadata API Developer Guide — `Workflow` Declarative Metadata Sample Definition** (api_meta.txt L140553–140736) — same PDF — the element order and shape reproduced in `references/metadata-examples.md`, *and* the documentation defect behind gotcha 8: the sample's `<fullName>Field_Update</name>` at L140666–140669 is not well-formed XML.

**Metadata API Developer Guide — `ApprovalProcess`** (api_meta.txt L23052–23075, sample L23607–23641) — same PDF — the `.approvalProcess` suffix and `approvalProcesses` folder (L23067–23071), the `finalRejectionActions` / `recallActions` blocks that reference an outbound message by name (L23615–23641), and the note that Knowledge `_kav` approval processes support Outbound Message as one of four action types (L23059–23061).
**Metadata API Developer Guide — `FilterItem`** (api_meta.txt L43897–43922) — same PDF — the `FilterOperation` enum used by `criteriaItems` in `references/metadata-examples.md` § 2.

**SOAP API Developer Guide — Understanding Outbound Messaging** (Summer '26 / 262.0) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api.meta/api/sforce_api_om_outboundmessaging_understanding.htm — the `notifications()` envelope, element by element: `OrganizationId`, `ActionId` ("the workflow rule (action) that triggers the message"), `SessionId` (nillable, "optional"), `EnterpriseUrl`, `PartnerUrl`, and `Notification` at `maxOccurs="100"`; the `Notification` datatype as an `Id` plus an `sObject` holding "the subset of the fields that you selected when you created the outbound message"; the idempotency instruction "use the object ID to track redelivery attempts of notifications you've already processed"; and `notificationsResponse` as "the schema for sending an acknowledgment (ack) response to Salesforce" containing exactly `<element name="Ack" type="xsd:boolean"/>`. This is the source that grounds the acknowledgment contract and gotcha 10.

**SOAP API Developer Guide — Building a Listener** — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api.meta/api/sforce_api_om_outboundmessaging_wsdl.htm — that the outbound messaging WSDL "defines the messages that Salesforce sends to your client application", unlike the enterprise or partner WSDLs; and the reference listener whose entire logic is `notificationsResponse r = new notificationsResponse(); r.Ack = true; return r;`.

**SOAP API Developer Guide — Setting Up Outbound Messaging** (Setting Up User Profiles / Defining Outbound Messaging / Viewing Outbound Messages / Tracking Outbound Message Status) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api.meta/api/sforce_api_om_outboundmessaging_setting_up.htm — "The chosen user controls data visibility for the message that is sent to the endpoint"; that the session ID "represents the user defined in the previous step and not the user who triggered the workflow"; the outbound port restriction (80 HTTP-only, 443 HTTPS-only, 1024–66535 either) and the endpoint certificate rules including "If your certificate expires, message delivery fails"; the infinite-loop Warning and the "Send Outbound Messages" profile permission behind gotcha 11; that the outbound message detail page lists "workflow rules **and** approval processes that use it" (the reverse index for gotcha 7); and the View Message Delivery Status actions — total attempted deliveries, Retry ("change the Next Attempt date to now"), Del ("permanently remove the outbound message from the queue").

**SOAP API Developer Guide — Outbound Messaging (chapter overview)** — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api.meta/api/sforce_api_om_outboundmessaging_listener.htm — that outbound messaging "uses the `notifications()` call to send SOAP messages over HTTP(S) to a designated endpoint when triggered by a workflow rule", and that it "is part of the workflow rule functionality in Salesforce".

**Salesforce App Limits Cheat Sheet** (v62 PDF) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf — **searched, negative result.** A case-insensitive grep for "outbound" returns one hit, about change-set file counts (L1038). No outbound message delivery, retry, queue-depth or throughput limit is published there, which is why every number in the retry discussion carries an UNVERIFIED marker.

**Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform** (v62 PDF) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf — **searched, negative result.** A grep for `OutboundMessage` and "Outbound Message" returns only unrelated Messaging and Voice hits. No queryable sObject exposes outbound message definitions or the pending queue, so post-deploy verification in this package is a Metadata API round-trip plus the Setup path, not SOQL.

**Salesforce Help — Outbound Message Actions** — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.workflow_outbound_messaging.htm&type=5 — the only remaining home for the retry cadence, the 24-hour delivery window, and whether a manual Retry extends that window. Referenced by the Metadata API guide itself ("For more information, see Outbound Message Actions in Salesforce Help", api_meta.txt L140315–140316). **Not fetchable from this environment**, which is why exactly those three claims still carry UNVERIFIED markers. The acknowledgment contract and the envelope, which previously rested on this page, are now grounded in the SOAP API Developer Guide bullets above.

**Salesforce Architects — Integration Patterns and Practices** — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/fundamentals/guide/integration-patterns.html — the framing for the Outbound Message vs Platform Events vs Apex callout tradeoffs above.
outputs: Workflow Rule Outbound Message action configuration
SOAP acknowledgment response template for the external endpoint
Delivery monitoring procedure via Setup > Process Automation > Outbound Messages
Retry management guidance for stuck or failed messages
